title: We're Some Way Apart on That
title_ar: احنا بعيدين شويّة عن بعض في النقطة دي
gist_ar: تفاوض مؤدّب. كل رقم بيتقال بصيغة مش مباشرة، والرفض بيجي على شكل موافقة.

before_listening.en: A negotiation in which almost nothing is said directly. Refusals arrive dressed as agreement, and every number is offered sideways.
before_listening.ar: تفاوض مفيهوش كلام مباشر. الرفض بيجي بشكل موافقة، وكل رقم بيتقال بطريقة غير مباشرة.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: Before we start — is Tuesday still realistic for you, or are we being optimistic?

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: Tuesday's realistic. Tuesday's realistic if the schedule attached on Thursday is the schedule we're working from.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: I'd have thought so. Broadly. There's a question about item nine that our technical people would like to be comfortable with, and I don't think it's a large question.

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: Then it's a large question. I'd rather say so now than at four o'clock.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: That's fair, and I'd rather you did. Look — we can live with indexation. In principle. What we're finding difficult is indexation from year one, with no collar, on a seven-year term. If somebody put year three in front of me I don't say I'd sign it today, but I'd take it to Hisham without a covering note explaining why I was wasting his time.

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: Year three. ... We're some way apart on that. Year two I could probably defend. Year three, I'd be going back to my board and telling them I'd given away two years of the thing I was sent here to protect, and they'd ask me what I got.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: Well. What would you want to have got?

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: Off the top of my head — and this is me thinking aloud, not an offer — the volume commitment in schedule two is currently a target. If it were a commitment, with the termination right falling away, then the indexation date becomes a much smaller conversation for me.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: Mm. The termination right is not mine to give away in this room.

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: No. I didn't imagine it was.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: But I could take the volume commitment on its own, with the termination right surviving, and I think that lands. And if that's where we are, then I'd want the collar as well as the date.

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: ...That I can do standing here. That costs me nothing I can think of, which probably means I should think about it for another minute. No — I can do it. Year two, floor at nought, volume becomes a commitment, termination survives.

segments.speaker: Ms Sabbagh
segments.text: Then I think we're closer than either of us expected to be before lunch. I'll have that written up and with you by six, and Tuesday stays Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Mr Kettani
segments.text: Tuesday stays Tuesday. And Farida — thank you for saying 'large question' rather than letting me find out at four.

gist_question.q: What has actually been agreed by the end?
options: Indexation from year three with a collar at nought
Nothing — the parties remain too far apart to proceed
Indexation from year two, a floor at nought, volume becomes a commitment, termination right survives
The termination right is given up in exchange for year three

questions.q: What does Ms Sabbagh mean by 'I'd take it to Hisham without a covering note'?
options: That she would need Hisham's written approval first
That the proposal would be credible enough to pass on without having to excuse it
That Hisham has already rejected the proposal once
That she would send it informally rather than officially

questions.q: Why does Mr Kettani say 'this is me thinking aloud, not an offer'?
options: Because he does not have authority to negotiate at all
To keep the volume commitment from being treated as a concession he has already made
Because he has misread schedule two
To signal the meeting should be adjourned

questions.q: What does 'We're some way apart on that' actually do?
options: Rejects year three politely while keeping the negotiation open
Accepts year three subject to board approval
Ends discussion of indexation altogether
Asks for the figure to be repeated

questions.q: Why does Mr Kettani hesitate before agreeing to the collar?
options: Because he needs his board's consent for any floor
Because a floor at nought is worth more than year two
Because it seems to cost him nothing, which makes him suspect he has missed something
Because the collar was not in the Thursday schedule

questions.q: What does Mr Kettani thank her for at the end?
options: Agreeing to keep Tuesday as the deadline
Consulting Hisham before the meeting
Naming item nine as a large question early rather than letting him discover it late
Dropping the termination right

glossary.word: off the top of my head
